answer: A newcomer's submission counts only after it presents a vertex chain to the timber registry: receipts signed across its last three epochs, each bound to its device key. The atlas panel replays the chain within thirty minutes, checking each signature against its epoch nonce. A copied receipt fails, since replay needs the original key for each nonce; a forged chain forfeits its bond and the identity sits out a cycle. One honest newcomer stakes fifty units once; a thousand fakes stake fifty thousand units in all, since each broken chain pays its bond to the panel.
